Meet The Team

Integrated Leadership and Corporate Wellness – Team

 

Christine D. François

Founder and Managing Partner, Francois Consulting Group (FCG), Executive Trainer

Christine D. François is a dynamic corporate communications, well-being and business consultant and event management professional with a proven track record of excellence in training and development. She is also the regional expansion team lead for a US-based wellness technology company. Having experienced the trauma of losing her spouse and other loved ones to NCDs, Christine brings her passion for empowering individuals and organizations to achieve their highest potential through holistic wellness practices. Christine is a former Employee Engagement Manager – Health and Wellness of one of the region’s leading financial institutions and brings over a decade of experience in business development, sales consulting, and project management to her role as an executive trainer.

Professional Certification
● Professional Diploma in Marketing – The Chartered Institute of Marketing, UK
● Diplomate (DLCC) – London Chamber of Commerce and Industry, UK

References
1. Bertnox Thompson – Vice President, J.P. Morgan Chase (Fmr.)
2. Marteka Swaby, Founder, Benevolent Health, London, England, United Kingdom.
3. Dr David Somekh, Network Director EHFF, European Health Futures Forum, England, UK
Website: www.ehff.eu

Judy Oxley Fullerton

Transformational Coach

Judy Oxley Fullerton’s expertise extends across regulatory compliance and strategic marketing. Her proficiency in business planning, coaching, sales, and team building underscores her capacity to navigate diverse challenges and foster organizational success. Moreover, Judy’s adeptness at training both staff and customers ensure seamless alignment with company objectives, bolstering operational efficiency and customer satisfaction alike.

Professional Certification
● MSc Organizational Leadership
● Post Graduate Diploma – The Chartered Institute of Marketing UK
● Financial Management Diploma – Association of Chartered Certified Accountants
● Personality DISC Assessment Consultant
● Certified Professional Transformation Coach – Coach Masters Academy

References
1. Ms. Dianne Charles – Distinguished Toastmaster, Registered Dietitian, Founder, El Shaddai Nutrition and Dietetic Services, Trinidad
2. Ms. Melissa Alexander – Manager, Fund Administration, First Citizens Depository Services Limited, Trinidad

Captain Wendy Yawching

Executive Trainer

Wendy Yawching is an accomplished leader, pioneering female aviator, and certified Master Feng Shui Consultant with a passion for personal and professional transformation. Wendy made history as the first female Captain of Trinidad and Tobago’s national airline, the first Trinidadian woman to reach Mt. Everest Base Camp, and the country’s first certified Master Feng Shui Consultant.

With a 28-year aviation career, Wendy retired as a Captain with Caribbean Airlines and later founded Healing Spaces Caribbean, offering Feng Shui consultations, workshops, and motivational speaking. As Environmental Director for Tobago’s Yahweh Foundation, she launched an award-winning environmental program for students. Wendy’s accomplishments, including being named a “Living Caribbean Legend” in 2023, reflect her leadership, dedication, and commitment to inspiring others. She is the self-published author of the transformational book, The Courage to Fly and has been invited to speak on transformational themes locally and regionally.

Her diverse skills in leadership, transformation, and wellness make Wendy an invaluable asset to our team.

References
1. Penelope Camps, Founder and CEO – Yahweh Foundation, Tobago
2. Lisa Alban, Chair, International Feng Shui Guild

Karl Thompson

Specialist – Applied Financial Education

Karl Thompson is an accomplished business and financial consultant with decades of experience in the financial sector and other segments of the economy. He has consulted households, businesses and governments nationally, regionally and globally.  Karl is a former Wall Street Banker, a successful entrepreneur and consultant, as well as an accomplished author. He has provided invaluable services to households, businesses and governments. He is known for his strong interest in business development and believes that human beings are the primary assets of any nation.

Karl’s passion lies in instilling the principles of financial education and economic sustainability in organizations and in the home – an essential foundation for economic development. He firmly believes that a financially educated leadership team can significantly drive an organization’s success while positively impacting the broader community. As Special Advisor to  this program, Karl brings invaluable expertise, stability, and innovative strategies that empower leaders to achieve financial resilience and growth. With a wealth of knowledge, a deep understanding of financial planning, and a warm sense of humor, Karl’s approach is both impactful and engaging.

In addition to his career achievements, Karl is a husband, father, and has authored books on finance, and the role of the father in a household.

Key Areas of Expertise:
● Organizational Financial Wellness & Sustainability
● Leadership Financial Strategy & Planning
● Building Financial Resilience in Leadership Teams
● The Role of Financial Education in Community Economic Development

Troy Hadeed

Troy Hadeed is an entrepreneur, author, yoga teacher, and social entrepreneur with over 20+ years of experience in the fields of mindfulness, emotional regulation, perspective-shifting and the ongoing exploration of the human condition. The first instant he stepped onto a corporate stage he realized how much of an impact we can have on social culture and wellbeing by shifting perspectives and cultures within the workplace. Human relationships are at the core of them both and if we can provide our workspaces with the tools to cultivate better relationships, not only will it increase workplace relations along with efficiency and profits, but also change the world.

Lisa Feveck

Lisa Feveck is a dedicated dietitian, educator, author and transformation coach who is passionate about supporting women with their health issues, especially through midlife and menopause. She understands the unique cultural and personal challenges faced by Caribbean women during this phase and is on a mission to simplify healthy eating, making nutrition more approachable and less stressful.

With a compassionate and holistic approach, Lisa prioritizes overall health and well-being, especially for those who prefer not to or cannot use medications. Her personalized coaching programs blend nutrition, fitness and mindset strategies, empowering women to embrace menopause with confidence and joy. Lisa believes this time is not just another chapter in a woman’s life but a chance to rediscover herself  and explore new possibilities.

Derval Barzey

Environmental Sustainability Advisor

Derval Barzey is a Speaker, Podcast Host and Environmental Sustainability Consultant. In 2020 she founded The Climate Conscious Podcast. She is dedicated to enhancing public awareness and amplifying the Caribbean perspective on climate action and sustainable development.

With a background in Energy and Environment, Derval brings over a decade of experience in areas such as Environmental and Social Impact Assessments, Risk Management Systems, and Sustainable

Energy Policy. Her expertise also includes Environmental Social and Governance frameworks. She has held roles in industry, and the public and private sectors.

Derval’s qualifications include:

  • MBA in Sustainable Energy Management-University of the West Indies
  • BSc in Environmental and Natural Resources Management, and Agribusiness – University of the West Indies
  • Sustainability and Climate Risk Certificate – Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP)

Derval is actively involved in regional climate justice advocacy, hosting the Caribbean Women for Climate Justice (CW4CJ) conference and contributing to the Caribbean Climate Justice Alliance.

Integrated Leadership and Corporate Wellness

Our Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness Program is designed to elevate performance, engagement, and organizational resilience by combining leadership development with holistic employee well-being. Through personalized executive coaching, interactive team workshops, and tailored consulting packages, we help companies foster a culture of trust, collaboration, and lasting wellness — empowering both leaders and teams to thrive.

Meet The Team

What We Offer

Tailored solutions to strengthen leadership, foster team collaboration, and promote holistic wellness across your organization.

1:1 Executive Coaching

Personalized coaching sessions designed to strengthen leadership skills, enhance decision-making, and foster resilience. Our executive coaching empowers leaders to navigate complex challenges while modeling wellness-driven behaviors for their teams.

Team Workshops

Interactive workshops that build collaboration, trust, and effective communication within teams. Participants engage in practical exercises that integrate leadership principles with wellness strategies to boost morale, productivity, and engagement.

Consulting Packages

Tailored consulting solutions that align leadership development and corporate wellness with your organization’s strategic goals. Flexible packages include actionable recommendations, implementation support, and options to request a custom quote for your unique needs.

About Us

Our Team is a collective of passionate change agents with a shared commitment to catalyzing personal and organizational transformation. Through our Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness (ILCW) program, we partner with visionary, like-minded organizations and professionals to help individuals, families, and communities thrive, starting within the workplace. We believe that organizations are powerful access points for lasting change, and our work is designed to elevate leadership, enhance well-being, and build resilient, purpose-driven cultures from the inside out.



Vision

To be the partner of choice across the Caribbean and Pan American region for Integrated Leadership and Immersive Holistic Corporate Wellness, delivering transformative programs that elevate people, performance, and purpose from the C-suite to the front line.



Mission

To serve as a trusted hub and catalyst for holistic well-being, resilient leadership, and collaborative growth, by designing and delivering tailored wellness experiences that:

  • empower individuals to reclaim their health, vitality, and voice.
  • enable teams to connect, trust, and thrive.
  • Invite every partner and contributor into a shared-value ecosystem where everyone wins.

Through this mission, we create a movement of wellness-centered leadership where inner alignment fuels outer impact.

Strategic Partners

Founder: Nicole Quan Kep
Power10HK & KEP-STAR
(Hong Kong)

 

Nicole Quan Kep is the founder of Power10HK and KEP-STAR, two Hong Kong–based enterprises that reflect her passion for connecting people, performance, and purpose across borders.

With over 25 years of international corporate experience and 15 years in athletic coaching and team management, Nicole has developed and advanced a distinctive approach to leadership and organizational wellness. At FDM Group—an award-winning global business and technology consultancy powering the people behind tech and innovation—she developed and advanced programs that enhance employee performance and growth, grounded in her coaching expertise and deep understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Her work helped elevate cultures of excellence, career progression, and employee well-being within the IT and Financial Services sectors.

Through Power10HK, Nicole integrates athletic training principles into corporate development strategies, creating transformative team-building experiences that drive connection, resilience, and measurable results.

As founder of KEP-STAR, she brings a Master’s Degree in Economics and Trade from Chongqing University and extensive experience in China sourcing and event management, enabling clients to access unparalleled networks and opportunities throughout Asia.

Nicole’s dual enterprises complement Francois Consulting Group’s Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness programs, amplifying their shared mission to foster high-performing, values-aligned teams and sustainable international growth.

Our Core Values

Guided by Purpose

Collaboration Over Competition

We believe in building bridges, not silos. Every partner, provider, and client contributes to a dynamic ecosystem of mutual benefit and collective success.

Whole-Person Empowerment

We see individuals as more than job titles. We design experiences that nurture the mind, body, spirit, and professional self.

Integrity in Action

We walk our talk, leading by example, making decisions aligned with our values, and holding space for honest conversations and accountable results.

Inclusion and Cultural Intelligence

We respect the diversity of the Caribbean and broader Pan-American landscape, and we aim to serve with empathy, equity, and cultural fluency.

Visionary Growth

We anticipate needs before they arise. By listening deeply and iterating boldly, we build programs and partnerships that evolve and endure.

My Why

My journey into wellness and transformation is anchored in faith. I’ve walked through grief, watched illness unravel someone I loved, and made choices no woman ever expects to make. But through it all, I never walked alone. God was there, whispering, guiding, comforting, and sometimes carrying me when I had no strength left. I believe nothing in my life has been an accident, not even the night a tiny stray kitten chose our doorstep and helped restart our hearts.

That moment was the beginning of a new chapter; one where healing, love, and purpose found their way back in. I believe that health is sacred, that our bodies and souls are deeply connected, and that every person deserves to feel whole. My work today is a direct extension of that belief. I’m not just here to help people improve their health. I’m here to remind them that they’re not alone, that they’re seen, and that restoration is possible, no matter how far gone things may seem. And if you’re reading this… you’re not here by coincidence either.

To be the partner of choice across the Caribbean and Pan American region for Integrated Leadership and Immersive Holistic Corporate Wellness, delivering transformative programs that elevate people, performance, and purpose from the C-suite to the front line.

Mission

To serve as a trusted hub and catalyst for holistic well-being, resilient leadership, and collaborative growth, by designing and delivering tailored wellness experiences that:

  • empower individuals to reclaim their health, vitality, and voice.
  • enable teams to connect, trust, and thrive.
  • Invite every partner and contributor into a shared-value ecosystem where everyone wins.

Through this mission, we create a movement of wellness-centered leadership where inner alignment fuels outer impact.

Strategic Partners

Founder: Nicole Quan Kep
Power10HK & KEP-STAR
(Hong Kong)

 

Nicole Quan Kep is the founder of Power10HK and KEP-STAR, two Hong Kong–based enterprises that reflect her passion for connecting people, performance, and purpose across borders.

With over 25 years of international corporate experience and 15 years in athletic coaching and team management, Nicole has developed and advanced a distinctive approach to leadership and organizational wellness. At FDM Group—an award-winning global business and technology consultancy powering the people behind tech and innovation—she developed and advanced programs that enhance employee performance and growth, grounded in her coaching expertise and deep understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Her work helped elevate cultures of excellence, career progression, and employee well-being within the IT and Financial Services sectors.

Through Power10HK, Nicole integrates athletic training principles into corporate development strategies, creating transformative team-building experiences that drive connection, resilience, and measurable results.

As founder of KEP-STAR, she brings a Master’s Degree in Economics and Trade from Chongqing University and extensive experience in China sourcing and event management, enabling clients to access unparalleled networks and opportunities throughout Asia.

Nicole’s dual enterprises complement Francois Consulting Group’s Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness programs, amplifying their shared mission to foster high-performing, values-aligned teams and sustainable international growth.

Our Core Values

Guided by Purpose

Collaboration Over Competition

We believe in building bridges, not silos. Every partner, provider, and client contributes to a dynamic ecosystem of mutual benefit and collective success.

Whole-Person Empowerment

We see individuals as more than job titles. We design experiences that nurture the mind, body, spirit, and professional self.

Integrity in Action

We walk our talk, leading by example, making decisions aligned with our values, and holding space for honest conversations and accountable results.

Inclusion and Cultural Intelligence

We respect the diversity of the Caribbean and broader Pan-American landscape, and we aim to serve with empathy, equity, and cultural fluency.

Visionary Growth

We anticipate needs before they arise. By listening deeply and iterating boldly, we build programs and partnerships that evolve and endure.

My Why

My journey into wellness and transformation is anchored in faith. I’ve walked through grief, watched illness unravel someone I loved, and made choices no woman ever expects to make. But through it all, I never walked alone. God was there, whispering, guiding, comforting, and sometimes carrying me when I had no strength left. I believe nothing in my life has been an accident, not even the night a tiny stray kitten chose our doorstep and helped restart our hearts.

That moment was the beginning of a new chapter; one where healing, love, and purpose found their way back in. I believe that health is sacred, that our bodies and souls are deeply connected, and that every person deserves to feel whole. My work today is a direct extension of that belief. I’m not just here to help people improve their health. I’m here to remind them that they’re not alone, that they’re seen, and that restoration is possible, no matter how far gone things may seem. And if you’re reading this… you’re not here by coincidence either.
